fail_closed_preconditions: resolve the boot disk from the live root=PARTUUID reference; never from a hard-coded device node
capture and reconcile the observed MBR disk ID, cmdline root PARTUUID, fstab PARTUUID, filesystem UUIDs, partition types, starts, sizes, and boot flags
require a 512-byte logical sector and a DOS/MBR table with exactly the verified p1 and p2 starts and identities
require current p2 size to be no larger than the exact 6 GiB target; shrinking is forbidden
require entries p3 and p4 to be absent and the proposed p3 range to have no filesystem, RAID, LVM, partition-table, or other data signature
require device capacity, 1 MiB alignment, 1 MiB trailing reserve, and at least 8 GiB of aligned p3 data space
require all required initramfs binaries, libraries, kernel interfaces, and durable storage for the pre-mutation backup to have been verified on the exact image
require marker, partition table, filesystem UUID, and volume sentinel state to be mutually consistent before treating a later boot as complete
required_mutation_sequence: mount only the identity-verified FAT boot partition at a private initramfs path
create an exclusive partition-table and first-sector backup before any table write
fsync the backup and directory, read it back, and verify its digest and captured identity
recheck the complete device identity and every precondition immediately before mutation
write only the bounded p2 end and verified-new p3 entry while preserving the observed MBR ID, p1, starts, types, flags, and references
reread and verify the table; never proceed after a partial or ambiguous result
run bounded ext4 check and grow operations; never shrink
format only the just-created, signature-free p3 as exFAT DASHCAM and capture its UUID
create and durably verify the volume sentinel and ext4 completion marker through a reviewed two-stage protocol
remove only the bounded trigger after complete marker reconciliation, preserve Imager firstrun tokens, and perform one controlled reboot
failure_contract: never format an existing or ambiguously identified partition
never continue to recording or silently fall back to rootfs
retain the bounded trigger and a durable failure record unless complete idempotency state is verified
use one bounded attempt per boot and a separately validated recovery or reboot path; no reboot loop
do not install or execute these inert templates as a production hook
